scenicChapters.title: Historic centre of the city of Lagos de Mo → Cemetery in Encarnación d
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 50 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-historic-centre-of-the-city-of-la.story: 412 km from Lagos de Moreno to Lagos de Moreno, about 7 h 06 of riding. On the way it passes Cemetery in Encarnación de Díaz, Former hacienda of Cieneguilla, Former hacienda of Pabellón de Hidalgo and Historic ensemble of the city of Aguascali. The highest point is about 2,250 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
